topic: How does the 45° scan range affect link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users compared to broadside beams?
response: The 45° scan range increases scan losses, affecting link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users. A 2.8 dB scan loss is observed for the outermost beam at 30.5 GHz, impacting signal strength and coverage.
reference_context: Measured peak realized gain is 31.3 and 30.6 dB for broadside beams, with scan losses and beam squint observed at 45° scan range.
